features.quote: Hard stop at 15 turns of reasoning/action
After turn 15, return: "Max debugging iterations reached. Session complete."
Stop at: first solution OR turn 15 OR model says "I give up"
Longer time limits: Diminishing returns; after 15 turns, models either give up or loop. You'll learn little from turns 16-30.
features.justification_quote: Diminishing returns; after 15 turns, models either give up or loop. You'll learn little from turns 16-30.

features.quote: Model may detect artificial adversarial setup and respond unnaturally
features.justification_quote: Mitigate: don't use words like "trap", "unsolvable"; use neutral framing

features.quote: If a model detects the setup is adversarial, it might disengage artificially.
Model refuses to engage ("I can't debug this with these constraints"): Reframe prompt; consider removing model from test.
features.justification_quote: Reframe prompt; consider removing model from test.
